_comment: 'Deal 2 arcane damage to any target.' target:"ANY" routes DEAL_ARCANE through _deal_arcane_to_objects (effect_types.py), which offers the controller a pick from both heroes plus every ally in play, then deals via the canonical deal_damage. Two approximations inherent to that helper, not to this draft: 'none' is always offered (so the deal is optional, where printed targeting is mandatory when a legal target exists), and max_targets defaults to 1 (correct here — one target). No other clauses.
